Kraken's own product pages establish SeaPower and Kraken SAS as concrete, differentiated technologies, while official order activity corroborates current commercial use. The refresh is additive, preserves the existing record, and gives reviewers a precise two-capability diff backed by durable first-party evidence.

fieldEvidence.excerpt: Kraken describes SeaPower as a subsea lithium-ion battery with pressure-tolerant encapsulation, integrated battery management and modular systems scalable from compact vehicles to XL platforms.
Kraken announced $35 million in SeaPower battery sales and stated that the batteries support long-endurance uncrewed underwater vehicle operations.
Kraken states that Kraken SAS performs imaging and bathymetric mapping simultaneously with modular arrays, constant swath resolution and real-time full-swath processing.
The official product page identifies mine countermeasures, port and harbour security, critical underwater infrastructure inspection and route survey among Kraken SAS applications.
Kraken's official newsroom lists continuing 2026 business updates and orders involving its subsea battery and synthetic aperture sonar portfolio.
